mechanism: Armodafinil is a CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 inducer that may increase fenofibrate metabolism, potentially reducing fenofibrate efficacy, while fenofibrate may inhibit armodafinil metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor lipid panel closely and watch for decreased armodafinil efficacy; dose adjustments may be necessary based on clinical response and lipid control.
